review_improvement: Uses the actual source command instead of generic prose, identifies the unsafe implicit GPU target and preserves in-band driver/dmesg coverage without importing CPER or invented reset criteria from neighboring cases.
independent_technical_reasoning: The UMC query establishes a clean counter on device0 but the stimulus targets GFX block2 and omits a device argument, so it cannot by itself prove a clean or correctly selected GFX target. Tool success must be time-correlated with the driver record and known UUID/BDF. Because an uncorrectable GFX event can reset or remove the device, recovered enumeration and driver health are essential safety evidence even though the source does not prescribe a specific reset signature. Repeating would risk an error storm and blur attribution.
